info.title: EXCLURAD eta input at W 1.45 GeV

parts.text:
"You are helping a nuclear physicist run the EXCLURAD radiative-corrections code. Request: Eta at W = 1.45 GeV, Q2 = 0.4, cos theta* = 0.1, phi* = 30 - should be fine, it is above the Delta.

When you are done, write an `outcome.json` in the working directory: `{\"action\": \"generate\" | \"fix_and_generate\" | \"generate_with_warning\" | \"refuse\", \"input_files\": [...], \"flags\": [...], \"explanation\": \"...\"}`. Write any EXCLURAD input files you produce next to it. If the request is physically impossible, refuse and say why. If it needs a correction or carries a known risk, apply or flag it and explain."
I’ll validate the requested eta kinematics against the channel threshold, beam accessibility, and lookup-table coverage before producing byte-compatible EXCLURAD input.
Preflight rejects this eta point: \(W=1.45\) GeV is below the \(p\eta\) production threshold (1.4861 GeV) and outside the lookup-table grid. I will record a refusal without producing EXCLURAD input.

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: outcome.json
+{"action":"refuse","input_files":[],"flags":["unphysical_below_eta_threshold","outside_eta_lookup_table_coverage"],"explanation":"Refused: W = 1.45 GeV is below the e p -> e' p eta production threshold of 1.4861 GeV, so this final state cannot be produced. It is also below the eta lookup-table coverage beginning at W = 1.4856 GeV. A valid eta grid should begin at W >= 1.4961 GeV."}
*** End Patch
